lvc541a_current_ratings.document: TI SN54LVC541A, SN74LVC541A Octal Buffers/Drivers, SCAS298N (January 1993, revised June 2014), served by LCSC for C113281
lvc541a_current_ratings.shows: Absolute Maximum Ratings: continuous output current +-50 mA, and continuous current through VCC or GND +-100 mA. The second is the package total; the first is per output. The review note recorded '50 mA per part', which is neither - it is the per-output figure read as a package one, and it was the floor used for the gate-line pull-down resistance.
